item.title: China's generative AI users surpass 700 million, report says

item.description: AI-powered design took center stage at the 2026 World Design Cities Conference, which opened in Shanghai on Monday under the theme “Design without Boundaries, Quality through Intelligence.”

item.title: Heilongjiang posts double-digit growth in goods trade from Jan-Aug
item.description: Heilongjiang Province's total goods trade reached 232.01 billion yuan (about $32.3 billion) in the first eight months of 2026, up 11.1% year on year, according to data released by Harbin Customs. Exports rose 21.7% to 71.73 billion yuan, while imports increased 6.9 percent to 160.28 billion yuan.

item.title: Beijing's Beihai Park opens historic Glazed Tile Precious Hall
item.description: The Glazed Tile Precious Hall at Beihai Park in Beijing opened to the public on Tuesday after being closed for more than 70 years.

item.title: Two major home-grown farm machines roll off production lines in Xinjiang
item.description: A full-power-shift high-horsepower tractor and a large grain combine harvester developed by China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited (CRCHI) have gone into mass production in Urumqi in Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

item.title: New high-speed rail link shortens Shangqiu-Beijing trip by almost an hour

item.title: PetroChina Southwest Oil & Gasfield achieves major output milestone
item.description: PetroChina Southwest Oil & Gasfield Company has surpassed 30 million metric tons of oil and gas equivalent output in 2026, reaching the milestone on Sept. 28 and setting a record for the same period in the company's history.

item.title: Shanghai Electric's latest Malaysian project marks a step forward for China's high-end power equipment in overseas markets
item.description: Shanghai Electric has secured the contract for Unit 3 of the Samalaju Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Project in Sarawak, Malaysia, marking the first overseas deployment of a heavy-duty gas turbine manufactured by the Chinese company. The deal is seen as a milestone in the international commercialization of China's heavy-duty gas turbine technology.

item.title: Poll: 57% of Japanese respondents say Tokyo should improve ties with China

item.title: Fujian coast guard conducts routine law enforcement patrols near Kinmen
